preview.title: LityOS phone v2 PR 4: rounded output and black backdrop
preview.summary:
Phone mode only (APK, no image change):
• The guest SurfaceView (inside the PR 2 margins) gets rounded corners, default 28 dp, via ViewOutlineProvider + clipToOutline. Chosen over any offscreen/per-frame work: the clip is applied by the compositor on the surface layer, so no per-frame cost in the app on the software-rendered Z Flip 7. The radius is capped to half the short side.
• Black sessionRoot backdrop whenever phone mode has margins or a radius > 0. One decision (SessionCorners.blackBackdrop) now drives the background, and it is reset with background = null (not a transparent colour), as the PR 2 reviewers asked.
• Radius is a pref (SessionPrefs.phoneCornerDp, 0..48, 0 = square). No UI yet (not cheap enough for this PR); say if you want a Settings control.
• A touch that starts in a black margin is swallowed until UP/CANCEL instead of being clamped to a click at the output edge (PR 2 review minor).
• Classic/tablet, PiP and glasses: no clip, no backdrop change.
